purpose: execute one bounded conditional entry-veto family under two real BBO carriers

controller_assumptions_not_claimed_as_ex.option_direction_mapping: buy call for long; buy put for short; no short options
controller_assumptions_not_claimed_as_ex.sizing_rationale: fixed units isolate signal/veto economics; identical capital and quantities for baseline/challengers inside each carrier; no leverage or sizing optimization; do not compare CAGR to the old fully-invested index account

roles.2021-2023: consumed development, entry-feature distribution calibration and diagnostic mechanism evidence only
roles.2024: consumed diagnostic support only; two missing spot BBO days prevent claiming complete full-year MDD
roles.2025: consumed retrospective primary full-account comparison; no threshold tuning or candidate-budget expansion after outcomes

signal: original 000688 5m+0 causal LP12 and sigma48 ddof0 k1 hysteresis; no formula/parameter changes
calibration: Fixed 25th/75th percentiles of original entry observations dated 2021-2023; no PnL enters thresholds. Apply these constants only after 2023.

family.small_work: work_efficiency_48 <= calibration q25 AND threshold_work_amplitude_48 >= calibration q75
family.fast_without_progress: fast_work_velocity_48 >= calibration q75 AND work_travel_threshold_12 <= calibration q25
family.union_four: logical OR of the four frozen mechanism conditions; no outcome-selected combination

entry_gate: Evaluate only at original signal reversals, latch admission until next reversal. Prior positions still receive normal exits. No hindsight removal of realised losses.

execution.decision_time: completed original index bar time, interpreted as Shanghai wall clock according to the accepted source convention
execution.order_not_before: decision time + 1 millisecond; carried pending targets may act at next session open
execution.fills: first eligible actually observed best ask/bid event after order, before next decision; observed quantity must cover fixed order; no added spread/slippage/impact
execution.cash: no borrowing; reject entry if insufficient cash; same rule all policies
execution.spot_T1: new buys locked until next trading day; latest target supersedes stale target while blocked
execution.option_selection: at entry-time visible underlying price and contract chain: nearest unexpired month then closest strike, deterministic code tie-break; hold selected contract, not a rolling synthetic ATM price
execution.expiry: close held expiring option by 14:55 on expiry day; roll with explicit exit/new-entry orders and fees if current admitted direction remains; after cutoff exclude same-day expiry
execution.marks: observed best bid at common five-minute and session-boundary marks; no future quote marks; unmarked held asset is a coverage incident
execution.final_positions: retain and mark legitimate unclosed inventory; report it, do not force prohibited T+1 sales or read 2026 to close
execution.corporate_actions: cash entitlement and contract adjustment require bounded source evidence before the affected account is admitted

primary_comparison: same carrier, same instrument, same period, capital, units, timing, inventory, and costs: MDD decreases AND average net PnL per completed trade increases
return_tradeoff: Report CAGR, net PnL, MDD in cash and percent, Calmar, trading count and retained/foregone return; keep full Pareto frontier. Calmar is a diagnostic, not permission to assume leverage scales returns linearly.
promotion: No automatic promotion from one complete economic year. Retain valid progression and distinguish failed/inconclusive conditions. Do not relax failed conditions or tune cutoffs after outcomes.
